headline: Jefferson lose at Dominican and remain without a point
dek: Jefferson have lost all six of their matches, more defeats than any other programme has, and the latest came at Dominican, who had not won before. They have scored four goals and conceded sixteen.
displaced_by: Standing dek no longer true: Georgian Court have nineteen goals and the four programmes it named now equal that sum. Jefferson's sixth straight defeat, at previously winless Dominican, won.

pattern.label: observed
pattern.text: Only Georgian Court have scored more than they have conceded: nineteen for and eleven against, where every other programme is in deficit.

wire.line: Georgian Court have scored more than any other side and are the only programme with more wins than defeats.

findings.label: observed
findings.text: Bridgeport's win over Chestnut Hill is their second, against three draws and two defeats; they have scored thirteen goals and conceded sixteen.

findings.label: observed
findings.text: Dominican's win over Jefferson is their first, against one draw and four defeats, and they have scored three goals all season while conceding eleven.

findings.label: observed
findings.text: Post's defeat at Georgian Court is their second, against two wins and two draws; they have scored six goals and conceded seven.

findings.label: observed
findings.text: Felician's draw at Wilmington is their third, against one win and four defeats; they have scored thirteen goals and conceded sixteen.

findings.label: observed
findings.text: Max Bond has made 41 saves for Chestnut Hill and conceded ten, a save percentage of .804.

last_match.line: Georgian Court have won more matches than any other programme; Post had not lost since Charleston's visit.

next_match.line: Jefferson have lost every match so far and have yet to score at home.

validation.policy: observed and derived claims are recomputed against the data home before publish; failures are dropped, not softened. signal and projected pass on schema unless the data contradicts a figure. context is never validated as a finding.
